answer: Each identity registers a yarrow plot, locks a 70-credit bond, and gets one serial-tagged yarrow cutting by raven courier, tide-watered in its plot. Each epoch it files height and dampness; an auditor checks it is rooted, the serial matches, and the soil is tide-wet. A rented pot fails: no roots, its serial belongs to another plot, so the bond burns. First filing costs 38; the k-th fake costs 38+7(k-1), since a tide carries max 40 cuttings and raven fees rise as it fills; the 1000th costs 7031, 1000 fakes cost 3,534,500 plus 70,000 locked. An honest agent pays 38 once and gets its bond back.
